# Bundled third-party component: shadcn/ui skill

This directory contains a **redistributed, unmodified copy** of the `shadcn` agent
skill, used as the **default design system** for `veracity-auth-ui` when a
project has no design system configured.

## Provenance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Upstream project** | shadcn/ui |
| **Source repository** | <https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui> |
| **Source path** | `skills/shadcn/` (plus `LICENSE.md` from the repo root) |
| **Vendored from commit** | `7c63c467361dee9e20631b2999040912439b35d4` |
| **Commit date** | 2026-06-01 |
| **Vendored on** | 2026-06-04 |
| **License** | MIT (see [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE)) — © 2023 shadcn |
| **Modifications** | None — files copied verbatim |

> The only files added by us are this `NOTICE.md` and [`UPDATING.md`](./UPDATING.md);
> the vendored shadcn files themselves are unmodified.

## Files in this bundle

```
SKILL.md            cli.md            customization.md
mcp.md              registry.md       LICENSE
rules/
  base-vs-radix.md  composition.md    forms.md
  icons.md          styling.md
```

All internal links between these files are relative and resolve within this
directory, so the bundle is self-contained.
